## [1.9.0](https://github.com/JoanComasFdz/baconreader-morphe-patches/compare/v1.8.2...v1.9.0) (2026-11-12)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **baconreader:** pause an ended comment video before its full screen starts it over ([b94e066](https://github.com/JoanComasFdz/baconreader-morphe-patches/commit/b94e066ac0050b8c555196275141d9467f76f392))
* **baconreader:** scroll a comment video whole into view when it grows ([96f237f](https://github.com/JoanComasFdz/baconreader-morphe-patches/commit/96f237f45e834fc30ecb35f20b0698457b681c51))
* **baconreader:** show a comment video's full screen without Android's prompt, and turn the screen back after it ([ba85673](https://github.com/JoanComasFdz/baconreader-morphe-patches/commit/ba856730c9043e91b9320d4c329591090de33d42))
* **baconreader:** show every error in the error dialog, labelled by its source, with a link to the issues ([91e2431](https://github.com/JoanComasFdz/baconreader-morphe-patches/commit/91e2431eda4cd658be8f02dfc24649d1e4967bd6)), closes [#142](https://github.com/JoanComasFdz/baconreader-morphe-patches/issues/142)

### ✨ New Features

* **baconreader:** add Open web pages in the browser, which opens links to web pages in the user's browser ([dc5a4a5](https://github.com/JoanComasFdz/baconreader-morphe-patches/commit/dc5a4a5ad5d7c809de8d5558168bf8130864960b))
* **baconreader:** add Swipe through albums, which goes to the next or previous image of a gallery or album with a swipe ([38719e1](https://github.com/JoanComasFdz/baconreader-morphe-patches/commit/38719e1e72fb6914605ef1a999c1169ba7b99aaf))
* **baconreader:** play comment videos at full width, with shrink and full screen buttons ([665ebad](https://github.com/JoanComasFdz/baconreader-morphe-patches/commit/665ebade1173e394b7740b81ab77eda48907768a))

patches.name: Account colors
patches.description: Lets you pick a color for each account in the menu, and shows the color of the account in use as a line under the toolbars.

patches.name: Disable feedback popup
patches.description: Disables the "Please take a few moments to provide feedback about BaconReader" popup.

patches.name: Disable final release announcement
patches.description: Disables the "FINAL RELEASE ANNOUNCEMENT!" popup that says goodbye when the app starts.

patches.name: Disable unavailable sidebar
patches.description: Disables "View Sidebar" on Front Page, All, Popular, Friends and multireddits, which have no sidebar.

patches.name: Embed comment images
patches.description: Adds options to show GIFs, image links, Imgur albums and emotes in comments and posts as images, play videos uploaded in comments and video links, show bare YouTube links with the video title and thumbnail, and show bare X and Bluesky links as the post.

patches.name: Fix Imgur API
patches.description: Fixes Imgur albums and galleries not loading, and image uploads in comments and posts failing.

patches.name: Fix Reddit links
patches.description: Opens Reddit's share links, and links to galleries, to videos, to posts without their subreddit and to posts on a user's profile, in the app instead of its browser.

patches.name: Fix Redgifs API
patches.description: Fixes Redgifs media not loading by using temporary Redgifs API tokens.

patches.name: Fix empty saved files
patches.description: Fixes saving media to the device also creating an empty file.

patches.name: Fix list thumbnails
patches.description: Fixes empty thumbnails in the post list, shows a preview as thumbnail for link posts and crossposted galleries and as image in the card of galleries, and blurs the thumbnails of NSFW and spoiler posts.

patches.name: Fix load more comments
patches.description: Makes "load more comments" load the hidden comments again.

patches.name: Fix lost post votes
patches.description: Fixes votes on a post disappearing from the post list when made while its comments load.

patches.name: Fix meme templates
patches.description: Fixes the meme templates of the drawing screen not loading, with Imgflip's most used templates.

patches.name: Fix slide show
patches.description: Fits each post of the Slide Show View to the screen, and lets a post's long text scroll in it.

patches.name: Fix unread messages
patches.description: Turns the orange inbox envelope back to normal when the last unread message is marked as read, and removes "Mark unread", which Reddit no longer supports.

patches.name: Flair filter
patches.description: Adds a "Flair" button to the sort bar of subreddits, to show only the posts with the chosen flairs.

patches.name: Hide formatted spoilers
patches.description: Hides spoilers (>!...!<) that contain formatting, links or code behind the spoiler box, instead of showing them in plain sight.

patches.name: Improve post media loading
patches.description: Shows a progress bar, the downloaded size and, by a setting, a still preview while post media and gallery images load, uses small previews for the thumbnails of galleries, shows a message instead of a broken page when a RedGIFs video was deleted, and adds options for which link post pages run JavaScript.

patches.name: Inbox comment reply screen
patches.description: Opens the comment reply screen, with the replied comment or message, when replying from the inbox, instead of the plain "Send message" form.

patches.name: Load more comments
patches.description: Adds options to load up to 500 comments when opening a post instead of about 200, and to load the "load more comments" with few replies automatically.

patches.name: Markdown editor
patches.description: Makes the text box of comments, replies, edits, messages and text posts as big as possible, adds a bar with Reddit's formats and a character counter above it, and shows the formatting while typing.

patches.name: Open web pages in the browser
patches.description: Adds a setting that opens links to web pages in your own browser, while images, galleries and videos keep opening in BaconReader.

patches.name: Prompt to open Reddit links
patches.description: Android does not allow the app to open Reddit links by itself. Asks once to set them up, and adds an option to open the "Open by default" screen.

patches.name: Reddit chat
patches.description: Adds Chat to the menu, next to the Inbox, which shows Reddit's chat from its mobile website on the main screen. The chat messages Reddit also sends to the inbox are counted next to Chat and notified as chat messages instead.

patches.name: Remove Log out
patches.description: Removes "Log out", which logs out of every account at once, from the menu's accounts.

patches.name: Remove Random feeds
patches.description: Removes Random and My Random from the feed list. Reddit removed r/random and r/myrandom in December 2024, so they never load.

patches.name: Remove awards
patches.description: Removes the award icons, "Give Award" and "View Award Details". Reddit's API no longer reports awards, and giving them used Reddit's discontinued coins.

patches.name: Save videos with sound
patches.description: Adds the sound to Reddit videos saved with "Save to device", which were saved without it.

patches.name: Search comments
patches.description: Adds a search button to the sort bar of posts, to find, highlight and jump between the comments with a text or user name, or show only those comments.

patches.name: Select text
patches.description: Adds "Select text" to the menus of posts and comments, which shows their text in a dialog where any part of it can be selected and copied.

patches.name: Show request errors
patches.description: Shows the actual error when a Reddit request fails, instead of the message saying that BaconReader stopped working in July 2023.

patches.name: Show tables
patches.description: Shows tables in comments and posts as a grid instead of "header: value" lines. Wide tables can be expanded and scrolled sideways, and links in tables can be tapped.

patches.name: Show user avatars
patches.description: Adds an option to show the author's avatar before the name in comments, as on Reddit's website, and always shows each account's avatar before its name in the drawer.

patches.name: Spoof client
patches.description: Makes logging in to Reddit work again by using another Reddit app's client ID.

options.description: The client ID of an "Installed app" from https://www.reddit.com/prefs/apps.
The redirect URI of that Reddit app. Empty keeps BaconReader's own, http://baconreader.com/auth.
The user agent of that Reddit app, ideally. Empty keeps BaconReader's own.

patches.name: Swipe through albums
patches.description: Goes to the next or previous image of a Reddit gallery or an Imgur album with a swipe left or right.

patches.name: Text post icon
patches.description: Replaces the expand button of text posts in the post list, which looks like a video play button, with a page icon and a chevron that flips when the text is expanded.

patches.name: Video autoplay in detail view
patches.description: Adds a setting to stop videos, such as v.redd.it videos, from loading and playing by themselves in a post's detail view: the post shows its preview image, and a tap on it plays the video.

patches.name: Account colors
patches.description: Lets you pick a color for each account in the menu, and shows the color of the account in use as a line under the toolbars.
